title: ZTIP Bundle
description: Accepts one ZTIP envelope object, an array of ZTIP envelope objects, or a wrapper object carrying them under `envelopes`. A wrapper may carry other metadata beside its envelopes; that content is outside every envelope hash, so a verifier reports it rather than verifying it.

oneOf.$comment: A wrapper carries envelopes; it is not one. An object declaring any ZTIP envelope field is an envelope even when it also carries an `envelopes` key — otherwise an envelope could hide behind a payload and never be validated itself.
